changes.description: Replaced static UTC window with dynamic EDT/EST timezone conversion rules for America/New_York (RTH 09:30 - 16:00 local time).
Added CME US Equities holiday calendar rules and early close handling.
Defined deterministic quarterly roll effective timestamps (Thursday before 3rd Friday of contract month at 00:00 America/New_York).
Explicitly decomposed 1.0 pt friction into 0.50 pt spread, 0.25 pt commission/clearing, and 0.25 pt slippage, with dollar values ($20 NQ / $2 MNQ).
Pre-declared 4 cost sensitivity scenarios (Low 0.5pt, Base 1.0pt, High 1.5pt, Stress 2.0pt).
Specified skipping signals generated on the final RTH candle (15:55 local time) to eliminate overnight holding.
Declared primary risk and drawdown accounting in both Points (pt) and USD Dollars ($).
Mandated logging 30-50 prospective session dates in session ledger prior to running signal generation.
